statement: Pinned SDL HIDAPI Wii code enables continuous data reporting, and after three seconds without input it treats the connection as lost and runs its disconnect path. The code comments describe attempting to reopen, but this logic does not demonstrate that reopening actually succeeds. This is a host inactivity/disconnect heuristic, not a device report cadence or measured radio timeout.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_wii.c:36-40 timeout setting,579-580 continuous reporting enabled,1536-1545 detection,1574-1576 disconnect path. Reopening is described as intent in a code comment only.
